_comment: Corrections applied on top of africa-g2p. `universal` fills in letters that individual rule sets omit even though the orthography uses them - the values are the conventional readings of these letters across Ghanaian Latin orthographies. `per_rules` fixes mappings that are wrong rather than missing, keyed by africa-g2p rule code. Every entry is applied only when the rule set does not already handle the character, so a language's own rules always win. Defects that were fixed upstream (africa-g2p#3, #4) have been removed from here rather than left as no-ops; pyproject pins the africa-g2p commit that contains those fixes.

c.note: c is /t͡ʃ/ in most Ghanaian orthographies

e.note: the gur rules mark e, i and o long ([eː] [iː] [oː]) while a, u, ɛ, ɔ, ɩ and ʋ stay short. The source chart used length to render the ATR contrast; these vowels are not phonemically long. Doubled vowels (aa, uu) keep their length mark.
